images.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: wide 16:9 premium travel website hero, photorealistic editorial illustration grounded in the place, natural textures and light, composition with calm uncluttered left side for white title. No words, logos, watermark, collage, frame or inset. San Antonio Arrazola Oaxaca Mexico, intimate family woodcarving workshop in a simple adobe courtyard. Foreground a small vividly hand-painted copal wood alebrije depicting an imaginative animal with finely dotted geometric ornament, several other colorful carved animals on a rustic workbench to right, carving tools and wood shavings, artisan hands applying a delicate brushstroke. Authentic Oaxaca craftsmanship, no oversized parade statues, no plastic souvenirs, no fake tribal costume.
